title: Pipeline Stage Gauntlet
prompt: Implement `Stage`: `put` feeds the inbox (value -1 closes it), `run` moves inbox values (+delta) to the outbox until closed, `take` blocks for outbox values.

tests.name: values transform and flow
tests.hint: Two mailbox slots (each mutex+cv+optional): run loops taking from inbox (waiting predicated), breaking on -1, otherwise pushing value+delta to outbox and notifying.

tests.name: late take blocks until value
tests.hint: take waits on the outbox condition variable with a predicate — the timing skew must not matter.
